NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
4937 — 49 North Western Avenue
From B3-3 to B2-3

The Property
The subject property is located on the east side of North Western Avenue and is improved with a one and two

story vacant building. The surrounding area along Western Avenue is zoned B3-3 and is improved primarily with
residential buildings ranging in height from two to five stories. The area to the east of the property is generally
zoned RS-3 and improved with residential buildings two and three stories in height with a surface parking lot
located immediately east of the property that serves a school at Claremont Avenue and Ainslie Street. The
property also is a Transit Served Location per the Transit Oriented Provisions of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance
(Section 17-10-0102-B (1)), as it is within 1,907 feet of the CTA Western Avenue Brown Line Station and also is
on Western Avenue that is a designated Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segment.

The Project
The Applicant proposes to demolish the existing improvements and construct a new five-story residential building

with 44 residential dwelling units (including 9 affordable units on-site), with 16 vehicular parking spaces, 44
bicycle parking spaces and no loading berths. As part of the rezoning, the Applicant seeks all relief necessary, as
allowed by the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, for the proposed project, including: 1) a variation under section 17-
13-1101-B to reduce the required rear yard (east side) setback from 30.0’ to 2.0 ft. 2) a variation to increase the
front yard setback from 5’ to 8’ under section 17-13-1003-P and 17-13-1101-A; and 3) a variation under section
17-13-1101-D to eliminate one loading berth as required per section 17-10-1100.

17-3-0308 Specific Criteria for Transit Served Locations Requirements
1. The project complies with the applicable standards of Section 17-10-0102-B:

RESPONSE: The project complies with Section 17-10-0102-B as the property is a Transit Served
Location within 1,907 feet of the CTA Western Avenue Brown Line trains station entrance.

2. The project complies with the standards and regulations of Section 17-3-0504, except paragraph H if the
project is not located along a pedestrian street and except paragraph C if the land use is designated in a non-
commercial use group, pertaining to pedestrian streets and. pedestrian retail streets, even if the project is not
located along a pedestrian street or a pedestrian retail street:

RESPONSE: The project is not located along a pedestrian street and does not include a commercial
uses group, so paragraphs C and H do not apply. As described below, the project complies with the
Section 17-3-0504 standards, except the building location standard for which a variation is sought as part
of the Type 1 rezoning because:

e Doors and Entrances: The building’s entrances face North Western Avenue;

© Off-Street Parking: 16 on-site automobile parking spaces will be provided;

e Parking Location: On-site parking will be to the rear and enclosed; and

e Driveways/Vehicle Access: The Applicant will provide access to parking areas from the alley.

3. The project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Development Guide: Station Area
Typology, and any other station-specific plans, designs or guidelines adopted by the Chicago Plan
Commission:

RESPONSE: The property is identified under the City of Chicago Metra Station Area Typology Study as
Local Activity Center, which characterized as an area with the highest density, multi-family uses,
redevelopment opportunities, and enhanced connectivity and amenities for pedestrians.

4, Residential building projects shall not have a number of parking spaces in excess of 50% of the Minimum
Automobile Parking Ratio for the applicable district listed in Section 17-10-0207 with any fractional result
rounded up to the next higher whole number, unless additional parking spaces are approved as
an administrative adjustment under the provisions of Section 17-13-1003-EE; and

5. The project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules of the Chicago Department

RESPONSE: The project will comply with applicable Travel Demand Study and Management Plan
rules promulgated by the Chicago Department of Transportation.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 13,804.56 sq. ft.

Floor Area: 42,850 sq. ft.

FAR: 3.15*

Residential Dwelling Units: 44

MLA Density: 310 sq. ft.*

Height: 60.0 ft.

Automobile Parking: 16

Bicycle Parking: 44

Setbacks: Front (N. Western) 8” minimum, 8’ maximum
Side (North) Vv
Side (South) Y
Rear (Alley) 2

*The project qualifies for an FAR increase under 17-3-0403-B and for an MLA reduction under 17-3-0402-B as the
property is a TSL location and all required affordable units will be provided on site.
